item.g:title: Puppy Calming Bed
item.g:description: Ultra-soft calming bed designed to provide comfort and security for anxious puppies. Features raised edges that create a safe, den-like environment perfect for separation anxiety. Machine washable cover and orthopedic support for growing pups.

item.g:title: Puppy Harness
item.g:description: Perfect for first walks and training! This adjustable no-pull harness grows with your puppy, featuring multiple sizing points for a secure, comfortable fit. No-pull design protects your puppy's neck and provides better control during training walks.
